verdict.rationale: Phoenix supports batch-style work over many items. You can run thousands of evaluations without writing retry or concurrency logic, group traces into datasets and rerun them across app versions, and evaluators attached to datasets auto-score whole experiments. Span querying with filtering is also documented. However, nothing describes general bulk operations such as multi-select edit, delete, annotate, move or export across many traces or examples. Missing for 10: bulk edit/delete/annotate operations on traces, spans or dataset examples; bulk actions via the SDK, MCP or CLI; independent hands-on corroboration.
